div.head: EGu 7.1
div.ab: Gyf friman freolsdæge wyrce, ðolie his freotes oððe gylde wíte, lahslite. Ðeowman ðolige his hyde oþþe hydgyldes.
Gif frigman freolsdæge wyrce, þolie his freotes oððe gylde wíte, lahslite. Ðeowman þolie his hyde oððe hydgyldes.
Si liber festis diebus operetur, perdat libertatem suam uel reddat witam (aut) lahslit. Seruus perdat corium suum uel hidgildum.
Gif frigman freolsdæge wyrce, þolie his freotes oððe gylde wíte, lahslite. Ðeowman þolie his hyde oððe hydgyldes.
Gif frigman freolsdæge wyrce, þolie his freotes oððe gylde wite oððe lahslite. Ðeowman þolie his hyde oððe hydgyldes.
If a freeman works during a church festival, he shall be reduced to slavery, or pay a fine or lahslit. A slave shall undergo the lash or pay the fine in lieu thereof.
If a freeman works on a holy day, he shall forfeit his freedom, or pay a penalty or lahslit. A slave will receive a whipping or pay to redeem himself.
Wenn ein Freier am Feiertage arbeitet, verliere er seine Freiheit oder zahle Strafgeld [bezw.] Rechtsbruchbusse. Ein Sklav verliere [in diesem Falle] seine Haut oder Hautgeld.
If a free man works on a feast-day, let him lose his freedom or pay a fine [or] the penalty for breach of law. Let a slave [in this case] lose his hide or the hide-money.
